name: face click
fusion: Clicking a face (TOP, FRONT, ...) animates the camera to that standard view.

notes: Face click goes to the right view but snaps instantly (Camera::set_view sets yaw/pitch directly). Fusion animates the camera over about 0.3 s.

name: edge click
fusion: Clicking one of the 12 edges animates to the 45-degree view between the two faces.

history.note: Only the 6 faces are hit-tested (viewcube() builds one quad per face). Clicking the band along an edge picks the nearest face. Fusion has 12 edge hot spots that go to the 45-degree view between two faces. StandardView has no edge or corner views.

name: corner click
fusion: Clicking one of the 8 corners animates to that isometric view.

history.note: Clicking the front-top-right corner went to TOP. Fusion has 8 corner hot spots, one isometric view each. Needs edge/corner hit zones (inset each face quad, so the outer band is edges and the corners are corners) plus arbitrary-direction views in Camera.

notes: Clicking the front-top-right corner went to TOP. Fusion has 8 corner hot spots, one isometric view each. Needs edge/corner hit zones (inset each face quad, so the outer band is edges and the corners are corners) plus arbitrary-direction views in Camera.
